title: senecio lanatus
intro: Senecio lanatus, commonly known as woolly groundsel, is a flowering plant species in the daisy family. This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, offering health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects, which may help alleviate symptoms of various conditions. The therapeutic actions of Senecio lanatus are attributed to its ability to modulate the immune system, reduce oxidative stress, and exhibit antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant, including sesquiterpene lactones and flavonoids, are responsible for its therapeutic actions.
